name: ackless
description: Open-source browser extension that hides Australian Welcome to Country and Acknowledgement of Country blocks.

scripts.check: oxlint src && oxfmt --check src && web-ext lint --source-dir . --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json bun.lock README.md LICENSE CONTRIBUTING.md test-page.html
scripts.build:chrome: mkdir -p dist && zip -r dist/ackless-chrome.zip manifest.json src icons README.md LICENSE
scripts.build:firefox: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json bun.lock README.md CONTRIBUTING.md test-page.html
